current_answer: 21 routes still meet the confirmed-open test after issuer-page rechecks. A RabbitHole Ecosystem Ambassador lead was held out: community posts link to issuer documentation, but that page was unavailable to inspect, so its application route and bounty terms are not confirmed.

catalogue_card.question: Can an ambassador bounty claim enter the Radar without terms?
catalogue_card.text: No. Community posts link to a RabbitHole issuer-docs page, but it was unavailable in this check. The lead is held out; 21 issuer-linked routes still meet the confirmed-open test.

summary: Rechecked issuer pages for Hedera, Cyfrin, Soneium, Elk, Nomis, Injective, Sogo and Bitget. Their displayed routes and previously recorded terms remain visible; Bitget still names 30 Sep 2026 as its recruitment close.
Added RabbitHole only as a held-out lead. Community posts point to issuer documentation, but the page was unavailable to inspect, so no application, eligibility or bounty claim was verified.
A popular post or an active community category is not a current route. The useful question before applying is whether you can inspect the issuer action and terms.
uncertainty: RabbitHole community posts are discovery leads, not proof of a current application or payment terms.
A visible issuer route does not prove selection, payment or a response.
Most confirmed-open routes still lack decision-ready cash terms, hours, full selection rules or independent participant reports.
freshness_note: Status reflects the last substantive check shown in each row. Eight issuer routes were rechecked on 25 Sep 2026. RabbitHole was kept out because its issuer-documentation endpoint could not be inspected. Re-open the issuer page before sharing identity data, wallet details, a CV or commercial contacts.
